PY

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil, sqlite3, json, os

src = Path('/app/main.db-wal').read_bytes()
dec = bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in src)
print('decrypted WAL first 32 bytes:', dec[:32].hex())
Path('/tmp/recover/main.dec.db-wal').parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
Path('/tmp/recover/main.dec.db-wal').write_bytes(dec)
shutil.copyfile('/app/main.db', '/tmp/recover/main.dec.db')
for p in ('/tmp/recover/main.dec.db-shm', '/tmp/recover/main.dec.db-journal'):
    try:
        os.remove(p)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass

con = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/recover/main.dec.db')
print('schema:', con.execute("PRAGMA table_info(items)").fetchall())
rows = con.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall()
print('count:', len(rows))
print('rows:', rows)
con.close()

assert len(rows) == 11, rows
out = [{'id': int(r[0]), 'name': str(r[1]), 'value': int(r[2])} for r in rows]
Path('/app/recovered.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n')
print('wrote /app/recovered.json')
PY
echo '--- recovered.json ---' && cat /app/recovered.json
